description: This Java class 'GroupsController' is a Spring MVC controller managing group-related administrative web endpoints, including displaying groups and group details, and handling paging requests for groups.

classes.name: GroupsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for handling admin user group management functions, including viewing group list, group details, and paginated data.

methods.name: displayGroup
methods.description: Handles GET request to display a specific group editing page based on group ID.

methods.name: displayGroups
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all groups for admin view.

methods.name: pageGroups
methods.description: Handles POST request for paginated retrieval of groups, returning JSON-formatted data.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up necessary menu attributes for the view within the request context.
